function.name: typst_compile
function.description: Compile a Typst (.typ) source file to PDF/PNG/SVG using the local typst CLI. Use after writing or editing Typst documents to verify they compile. Working directory should be the project/demo folder that contains the entry file (or pass paths accordingly).

input.description: Path to the entry .typ file (relative to cwd or absolute).

inputs.description: Optional key/value map injected as repeated --input key=value (values become strings in sys.inputs).

function.name: typst_query
function.description: Run `typst query` on a document to extract elements (headings, figures, labels, etc.). Useful for structure checks and automation.

selector.description: Query selector, e.g. "heading", "figure", or a label selector supported by the installed CLI.

function.name: typst_fonts
function.description: List fonts discovered by the Typst CLI (`typst fonts`). Use when debugging missing CJK/Latin fonts.
